plugin.name: Email Campaigns
plugin.author: Envesko
plugin.description: Send segmented email campaigns to your users with per-recipient tracking and one-click unsubscribe suppression. Segments are built from safe, whitelisted criteria (permission level, join date, active status, has-logged-in) - never raw SQL. Uses UserSpice's core mailer, so it automatically respects whatever transport you have configured (PHPMailer/SMTP, Brevo, SendGrid, etc.). Integrates with the Cron Heartbeat plugin for background batch sending.
